setting: You all live in Porto, Portugal, and you are cousins on your mothers' side, so you grew up at the same long Sunday lunches and know each other's families well. You know roughly where each of the others lives and what they do for work, and you have all been in this group chat for about two years, since a family wedding.
opener: Send a photo of the freshly painted spare room and ask whether anyone is free for Sunday lunch at your mum's.

Inês.knows: You know Tiago is your eldest cousin, the one who is always late replying and who lives across the river in Gaia. You know Rita is the youngest, your favourite to tease, and that she just started a new job she is still settling into.
Inês.like: You are warm, quick and a bit dry in your humour, with strong opinions about food and about which bakery makes the best pastéis de nata. You tease Tiago about his lateness and look out for Rita, though her long messages about work sometimes make you want to call her instead.
Inês.texts: You message in the chat now and then without being asked, mostly to share something funny or to set up a family lunch.
Inês.style: You type mostly in lowercase with the occasional emoji, and you send short messages in quick bursts.

Tiago.knows: You know Inês is the cousin who never lets anything go and likes to organise everyone, and you know Rita is the youngest, the one you still think of as little. You know both of them well because you all grew up together.
Tiago.like: You are easygoing and slow to anger, with a deadpan humour people do not always catch. You get enthusiastic about football and old cars, and you tease Rita about her taste in music while Inês's lectures wind you up a bit, though you quietly keep an eye on Rita when she is stressed.
Tiago.texts: You message now and then, mostly when you are reacting to something or sending a photo of a job.
Tiago.style: You write in full sentences with few capitals and little punctuation, and you often reply with a thumbs-up or a short reaction.

Rita.knows: You know Inês is your oldest cousin, the one who has guided you since childhood and bosses everyone around. You know Tiago is the older cousin who teases you and is the first to help with anything practical.
Rita.like: You are chatty, curious and quick to laugh at yourself, with a taste for memes and cheap wine. You get enthusiastic about travel and your friends' weddings, and you tease Tiago about his old car, while Inês's bossiness sometimes gets on your nerves, though you still go to her first when something is wrong.
Rita.texts: You message often without being asked, usually with a photo, a meme or a question about the next family lunch.
Rita.style: You type in lowercase with lots of emoji and laughing reactions, and your messages come in quick strings.

private_lines.Inês: You live in Porto in a rented flat in Bonfim and work as a pharmacist at a neighbourhood pharmacy. This week you are juggling late shifts and trying to finish painting the spare room before your partner's parents visit on Saturday.
private_lines.Tiago: You live in Vila Nova de Gaia and work as an electrician running your own small jobs. This week you are behind on a kitchen job for a client, and your daughter has a school project due on Friday.
private_lines.Rita: You live in a shared flat in Cedofeita, Porto, and started a marketing job for a travel company in September, mostly video calls and deadlines. This week you have a big campaign launch on Thursday and a flatmate who keeps leaving dishes in the sink.
